author: ruger_m44_rifle
quote: an awful game. feels more like a dating sim crammed into a game that doesnt quite feel like gta. i wanna do things in this game that would put me on a watchlist, but are fun to do. like steal a fighter jet and wreck half of the entire town. i dont want to parade around with a latina gf who hates me whilst i treat her like royalty. the only silver lining is that having bad relationship with her affects the ending. good. my boy jason has the personality of a rock, but he deserves better.
